commit.message:
Phase 41e CLOSES, and with it Phase 41 and the RECONCILE program: the status surfaces, the row and the queue

The close's part 2b, the umbrella-phase close of Phase 41 (PHASE-BOUNDARIES.md
*When this commit closes a phase*, the full-phase close) and the close of the
RECONCILE program. Parts 1 (`1ff52359`: the Lean gates and the axioms on the
final tree, the ledger's last dispositions) and 2a (`24d631b5`: the re-reads
and the compressions) stand; no Lean changes here. ORIGAMI is not opened, and
nothing is pushed: the loop stops for the PI's push (design doc §1j.5).

- ROADMAP: the Phase 41 row flipped to done and re-thinned to a pointer;
  section 41 compressed to one paragraph plus pointers (the five sub-phases
  by stable code); section 34 names M1's maximum-rank form, the main result
  since M1K, beside the generic form it keeps; the RECONCILE bullet
  compressed to the three rounds, the phase and the ledger's end state, with
  ORIGAMI next, opening with the PI.
- `.claude/autopilot/queue.toml`: the RECONCILE-FORMAL row `done = true`.
- notes/Reconcile.md: its Status rewritten in closed form; section 1, the
  PI's verbatim decisions, byte-identical.
- notes/Phase41-design.md: the Status header in closed form, section 3's
  UNSTATED row done (30 commits: 21 within the plan's 18-24, the PI's
  section-1k record and 8 verification fixups), and the program-close
  sentence in the past tense; sections 1 to 1k byte-identical.
- notes/Phase41e.md in closed form: the forward part is the hand-off (the
  PI's push, then ORIGAMI with the PI), the checklist one line per item with
  its commits, Decisions made one-line verdicts with the PI pointers kept.
- notes/MolecularConjecture.md: the Phase 41 entry closed; ORIGAMI the next
  phase to open, with the PI.
- The user-facing surfaces re-summarized, the sub-phase blow-by-blow folded
  into "phase 41": README and the home page (the link condition, the generic
  body-hinge theorem for every multigraph and its panel-hinge companion for
  every simple graph, each on one body or more, the qualifier kept per
  result; the body-hinge theorem at Katoh-Tanigawa's own genericity; one
  sentence on the review phase 41 ended; the home page's phase 41 row done);
  intro.tex (the "in progress" dropped, the form at hinge points at
  Katoh-Tanigawa's genericity in the Organization subsection's generic-form
  paragraph, and the reading paragraph: every node green, and the review;
  the enumerate's items, phases 1-26, needed no change); formalization.yaml
  (status.scope gains phase 41's summary, and fidelity.divergences' "a
  cleanup now under way" becomes the closed cleanup).

Gates: `blueprint/lint.sh`: "all static reference checks passed."
`blueprint/verify.sh` (inv bp, inv web, lake exe checkdecls): "all gates
passed.", checkdecls silent. `python3 notes/check-phase-note.py`: "OK: 1
phase note(s) checked (changed vs HEAD); all within cap." (`--all`: 115
checked, all within cap). formalization.yaml parses, 20 main results.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
